FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 55
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs and Public Safety Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 01/14/2026
Senate Bill 55 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama
Department of Workforce by an undetermined amount to maintain a registry of private
employers that establish a voluntary veterans' preference employment policy pursuant to the
provisions of this bill.
